FIELDS.NAME: Bloom & Blossom Florist
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Flower Lane, Suite 100, Garden City, NY 11530-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Bloom & Blossom Florist, we specialize in providing high-quality floral arrangements for a variety of occasions, including weddings, corporate events, and everyday celebrations. Our operations are centered around a licensed retail storefront where we maintain compliance with local health and safety regulations. We work closely with trusted suppliers to source fresh flowers and greenery, ensuring that we provide our customers with the best possible products. Our team is trained in safe handling procedures and customer service, allowing us to fulfill orders promptly while maintaining high customer satisfaction ratings. We also conduct regular risk assessments to mitigate any operational risks associated with our delivery and event setup activities. All offsite setups undergo mandatory safety assessments to ensure safe working conditions for our staff and clients. Additionally, we implement secure packaging and route planning for all deliveries to minimize product loss or damage, thereby enhancing our service reliability and reputation in the community.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Flower Delivery Services LLC, 456 Blossom Avenue, Garden City, NY 11530-5678
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to an unexpected refrigeration failure on May 15, 2023, resulting in the spoilage of perishable floral arrangements, totaling $1,800. Current status: being assessed for insurance coverage. Additionally, on June 10, 2023, a delivery vehicle accident caused cosmetic damage to the truck, amounting to $700, which has been repaired and the cost covered by the business account.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, Class B, UL listed for cash and valuables storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing installed around the property and monitored by security personnel during high-traffic events.
